_source: GitHub REST API responses for vimma-browser/vimma, trimmed to the fields decide() reads. bumpPulls: GET /repos/{repo}/commits/d481400/pulls (PR #186, upstream: firefox 158.0). releasePulls: GET /repos/{repo}/pulls?head=vimma-browser:release-please--branches--main for PR #347 while it was open. user: GET /user with RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN. compare: GET /repos/{repo}/compare/{bump}...{release head}. releases: GET /repos/{repo}/releases?per_page=1.
